AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.

3. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

7. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.

8. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.

9. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

11. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

12. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

13. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

14. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.

15. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
